{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Remove baseline biomarker rows with -999 (QC failure)
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Correct assay_batch B: divide biomarker_final by 10 (since it's in µg/L, not ng/mL)
df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Now compute response rate per site
table = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Print result
table"}
